1.w: A psalm by Asaph. El, God, the Lord has spoken, and summoned the earth to come from the east and west.

2.w: From Zion, the most beautiful of all places, God has come in splendor.

3.w: “May our God come and not be silent.” Consuming fire goes ahead of him, and all around him a storm rages.

4.w: He summons the heavens above, as well as the earth, so that he might judge his people.

5.w: He says: “Assemble my covenant people before me, those who ratified a covenant with me by sacrifice.”

6.w: The heavens declare his fairness, for God is judge. (Selah)

7.w: He says: “Listen, my people. I am speaking! Listen, Israel. I am accusing you. I am God, your God!

8.w: I am not condemning you because of your sacrifices, or because of your burnt sacrifices that you continually offer me.

9.w: I do not need to take a bull from your household or goats from your sheepfolds.

10.w: For every wild animal in the forest belongs to me, as well as the cattle that graze on a thousand hills.

11.w: I keep track of every bird in the hills, and the insects of the field are mine.

12.w: Even if I were hungry, I would not tell you, for the world and all it contains belong to me.

13.w: Do I eat the flesh of bulls? Do I drink the blood of goats?

14.w: Present to God a thank offering. Repay your vows to the Most High.

15.w: Pray to me when you are in trouble. I will deliver you, and you will honor me.”

16.w: God says this to the evildoer: “How can you declare my commands, and talk about my covenant?

17.w: For you hate instruction and reject my words.

18.w: When you see a thief, you join him; you associate with men who are unfaithful to their wives.

19.w: You do damage with words, and use your tongue to deceive.

20.w: You plot against your brother; you slander your own brother.

21.w: When you did these things, I was silent, so you thought I was exactly like you. But now I will condemn you and state my case against you.

22.w: Carefully consider this, you who reject God. Otherwise I will rip you to shreds and no one will be able to rescue you.

23.w: Whoever presents a thank offering honors me. To whoever obeys my commands, I will reveal my power to deliver.”
